description: For a finite-character family and a nonempty inclusion-chain of its members, the union of the chain belongs to the family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.finite_character_chain_union.{u} {α : Type u} (F : Set (Set α))
  (hF : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.FiniteCharacter F) (C : Set (Set α)) (hne : C.Nonempty) (hC : C ⊆ F)
  (hchain : IsChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) C) : ⋃₀ C ∈ F
